rationale: C15 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are presidential letters that announce the formation of a committee, designate the recipient as chairman, give the chairman latitude to involve other departments or agencies, and describe the committee’s coordinating purpose. The close sequence and wording go beyond generic committee-related boilerplate. C08 and C09 share the establishment-and-chairman letter structure but are less close regarding flexible membership and broader agency assistance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: With the thought that it will be most helpful to coordinate the planning, I am suggesting the formation of a Veterans Day National Committee.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: A coordinated Federal approach and a full utilization of existing resources will make possible more effective action... As you have suggested, I am establishing an Interdepartmental Committee on Migratory Labor
shared_material.explanation: Both introduce a committee as the mechanism for coordinating otherwise dispersed activity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In view of your great personal interest as well as your official responsibilities, I have designated you to serve as Chairman.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am designating you as Chairman.
shared_material.explanation: The central appointment language is nearly identical and occupies the same place after the committee’s establishment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You may include in the Committee membership such other persons as you desire to select
shared_material.parent_excerpt: there are other departments and agencies which have major interests in specific areas, and I shall expect you, as Chairman, to keep them informed and to invite their participation as needed.
shared_material.explanation: Both give the designated chairman discretion to expand participation beyond the initially specified body.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am requesting the heads of all departments and agencies of the Executive branch to assist the Committee in its work in every way possible.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my hope that this Committee will aid the various Federal agencies... in developing cooperative relationships between the Federal agencies
shared_material.explanation: Both rely on executive-branch cooperation as the committee’s principal administrative machinery.
